title: Renew or restore an individual property licence
summary: This page provides information on how to renew or restore an individual property licence online.
intro:
If you hold an individual property licence, a renewal notice will be emailed to you prior to your licence expiry date. You will then be able to renew your licence online.

If your licence has expired:

You cannot work if your licence has expired.

To find your property licence number and details, visit Verify NSW.
who_can_apply: Have received a licence renewal notice from NSW Fair Trading
Be a fit and proper person to hold a licence and not be disqualified
Apply within 3 months from the expiry date of your licence

how_to_steps.text: Select the 'Renew or restore online' button.
Log in, or create your MyService NSW Account.
Follow the prompts to renew or restore your individual property licence.

faqs.q: What happens if my property licence expires?
faqs.a: You cannot work if your licence has expired.

faqs.q: How can I find my property licence number and details?
faqs.a: You can visit Verify NSW to find your property licence number and details.

faqs.q: How do I renew or restore my individual property licence?
faqs.a: Select the 'Renew or restore online' button, log in or create your MyService NSW Account, and follow the prompts.
